title: 门店人效及人工占比
context: 人力＋销售联合分析：管理层要求以同一企业口径核对业务数据。
requirements: 2025年线下门店，按员工月归属门店的人力成本、出勤+加班工时；销售每小时及人工占净销售比例；保留所有门店。
commonError: 不得使用当前归属替代历史岗位或重复累加月薪。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(labor_cents) labor,SUM(worked_minutes+overtime_minutes) minutes_worked FROM v_staff_month WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' AND store_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(b.labor,0) labor_cents,ROUND(1.0*COALESCE(b.minutes_worked,0)/60,2) worked_hours,ROUND(60.0*COALESCE(a.net,0)/NULLIF(b.minutes_worked,0),2) sales_per_hour_cents,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(b.labor,0)/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) labor_pct FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY s.store_id
